les_modalites_revelent_la_maniere_dont_v: The modalities reveal how your energy naturally moves and evolves through experiences.
les_modalites_decrivent_votre_facon_natu: The modalities describe your natural way of approaching situations. They show whether you tend to initiate projects, sustain them, or adapt to changes.
combinees_aux_quatre_elements_elles_appo: Combined with the four elements, they provide a more complete view of your functioning and your way of evolving.
aucune_modalite_n_est_superieure_aux_aut: No modality is superior to the others. Their distribution simply reveals your preferred way of acting and reacting in different life situations.
